name: Copper
one_liner: Copper is a CRM with a RESTful Developer API.
auth_notes: API key via X-PW-AccessToken plus X-PW-UserEmail headers; OAuth2 for partner integrations.
access_notes: API available on trial, Professional and Business plans (not Basic). Keys generated self-serve in System settings > API Keys.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys but API only on trial/Professional/Business plans. Documented REST API, webhooks and rate limits.

identity.quote: The API provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to use Copper entities.

auth.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.

access.quote: Available on our trial, professional and business plan
in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY' button.

api_surface.quote: Webhooks allow systems integrated with Copper to receive near real-time notification of certain events
All API calls are limited to 180 requests per minute.

buildability.quote: Available on our trial, professional and business plan

disputes.why: Webhooks overview documents create/update/delete subscriptions for several record types.
requests.html documents 180 requests/min and bulk 3 req/s.
